sentences.text: The incident review found that the dashboard showing pool usage was not connected to an alert, so the slow shrinking of the pool went unnoticed for six days.
The review states that the skipped weekend restart, a deliberate customer accommodation, has to be accompanied by monitoring that covers long running processes.
The resulting action item AI-2 was an alert that fires when pool usage stays above 80 percent for 15 minutes, and it was completed on 2026-03-26.
Action item AI-1 also added a regression test that runs the connection pool for the equivalent of seven days.
